name: Zip Up
storyline:
MC (customizable) is a personal stylist working under celebrity stylist and personality Aphrodite Noire, who manages some of Hollywood’s biggest clients. After MC manages to save a major photoshoot gone awry, Aphrodite decides to reward MC with A-lister clients.

But to MC's horror, Aphrodite hands over three of their toughest clients:

- Drake Ridion, the arrogant, method-acting A-lister who refuses to play leading man unless you meet his demands
- Mirage Valland, the triple-threat, sparkle-loving superstar striving to become this year’s awards season darling
- Archer Everett, an overnight reality TV sensation (and living meme) who wants nothing to do with fame even though it keeps finding him at the wrong place at the wrong time.

Now having to dress and wrangle these three through their big showbiz seasons, MC's world of lights, camera, and all things fashion is about to be turned upside down.
summary: As a stylist working for Hollywood's biggest celebrities, dress up your troublesome clients for their showbiz events and somehow manage a romance with a celebrity in this story-driven dress up game inspired by reality TV & Hollywood culture
